title: Page 32 signed prime gaps did not match payload-junction residues
claim: The exact signed displacement-transition residues matched zero of fifteen consecutive payload-junction residues positionwise; the upper-tail probability under the frozen p=1/29 null is 1.0.
why_it_matters: It closes the exact direct vector mapping before broader fitting can create post-hoc matches.
controls: No shift, reversal, sign inversion, alternate register, or neighboring-rune search.
limitations: Only the exact positionwise mapping was tested.
does_not_claim: That every Page 32 numeric relationship is invalid.
current_interpretation: Reproduced bounded negative for the declared signed-gap vector mapping.
